stories.title: Brunswick Road could be pedestrianised again, council confirms
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council says there is no guarantee that Brunswick Road in Buckley will stay open to traffic once its trial period ends, and has set out how it will decide. stories.title: Mold theatre to stage A Doll’s House, The Secret Garden and new Lucie Lovatt thriller
stories.summary: Theatr Clwyd in Mold has announced its spring 2027 season, featuring three new productions. The season opens with Simon Stephens’ adaptation of Henrik Ibsen’s A Doll’s House, running from 27 March to 17 April, directed by Dena Davies, who recently completed Theatr Clwyd’s emerging director programme. stories.summary: Rhug Estate is once again throwing its support behind a remarkable mountain challenge which will help provide Christmas dinners for homeless and vulnerable veterans across Wales. stories.title: North Wales Police visit 56 children in month-long online safety operation
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s Online Child Abuse Investigation Team carried out 56 visits to children and family members during August as part of a month-long safety operation. stories.title: Simply Red to play Chester Racecourse in August 2027
stories.summary: Simply Red will play Chester Racecourse next summer, with the band confirmed to headline the venue’s Open Course on Saturday 7 August 2027.
